claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Oura maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The total requested withdrawal is 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Oura is a Rust-native pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs for processing.
Oura supports multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and supports sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The proposal states that Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors and identifies it as the most starred project in the TxPipe portfolio.
The proposal states that Oura is used across the ecosystem for indexing, monitoring, analytics, and real-time event processing.
The proposal states that Oura achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
The proposal states that TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Treasury funds will be administered through Sundae Labs smart contract infrastructure with Intersect admin and leadership roles plus an external Oversight Committee providing multi-party checks on specified actions.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Oura maintenance and administration, describes Oura as open-source Cardano event-pipeline infrastructure, cites governance-process and NCL compliance references, and provides smart-contract fund-management details.
